en.settings.double_click_components: Double-click a component to activate it, or to edit a linked one in place
en.ui.edit_in_place_after_turn: The edit finishes when the agent's turn ends
en.ui.edit_in_place_agent_busy: The agent is still working in this design; try again once its turn is done
en.ui.edit_in_place_already_queued: An edit already waits for the end of the agent's turn
en.ui.edit_in_place_busy: Finish or cancel what is open first
en.ui.edit_in_place_none: No linked design is edited in place
en.ui.edit_in_place_not_saved: The part has changes that are not saved; save it to finish editing
en.ui.edit_in_place_opens_after_turn: The part opens when the agent's turn ends
en.ui.edit_in_place_refresh_dropped: The assembly changed while Update Links ran; run it again
en.ui.edit_in_place_refresh_stopped: Update Links stopped before it was done
en.ui.edit_in_place_save_first: Save the assembly first: its linked designs are found from its file
en.ui.edit_in_place_save_waits: Update Links is running in {name}; save it once it is done
en.ui.edit_in_place_saved_elsewhere: The part was saved to another file; the assembly still links {name}
en.ui.edit_in_place_wait: Wait until what is running in the design is done
en.help.component.finish_edit: Saves the part you are editing in place, returns to its assembly and updates the assembly from it. Use it when your changes to the linked part are done.
